_why: 3.6: SHATTER SCROLL, read in a fight by a fighter who never learned the spell and has no slots. The scroll branch in resolve_cast_shatter is checked before the slot spend, so spell_slots_2 is untouched and the scroll is gone after one read. Expect the 3d8 thunder at its 2nd level on the clicked or weakest foe in medium reach and every foe on its tile, each with a Constitution save for half.
